No WebMCP tools are registered, so an in-browser agent must reverse-engineer your UI — clicking around and guessing at selectors — instead of calling your functionality directly.

if (navigator.modelContext) {

    tools: [{
      name: 'search_products',
      description: 'Search the catalogue by keyword',
      inputSchema: { type: 'object',
        properties: { query: { type: 'string' } },
        required: ['query'] },
